title: Knight Transportation Named WK Kellogg’s 2025 Carrier of the Year
summary: Knight Transportation earned WK Kellogg’s first-ever Strategic Asset Carrier of the Year and Uber Partner Carrier of the Year awards for reliable freight capacity.
body_markdown:
Knight Transportation is proud to be named WK Kellogg’s 2025 Carrier of the Year, an award that highlights what we can achieve through true partnership, dependable execution, and exceptional customer care.


WK Kellogg Co named us their **2025 Strategic Asset Carrier of the Year** and **2025** **Uber Partner Carrier of the Year!** Taking home both honors is a milestone we do not take lightly, and we’re deeply appreciative of the recognition.


Moreover, this marks the very first year **[WK Kellogg](https://www.wkkellogg.com/)** has created these prestigious awards. As a result, Knight Transportation is the inaugural carrier to earn both honors.


## Delivering More for WK Kellogg


These honors, Strategic Asset and Uber Partner Carrier of the Year, recognizes top-performing trucking partners that handle high-volume lanes and collaborate on long-term supply chain planning. Winners must also provide reliable capacity during peak season and market disruptions.


**Knight excelled in several key areas:**


- On-time pickup and delivery
- Strong communication and visibility
- Safe driving and freight handling


As a member of WK Kellogg’s core carrier group,[Knight Transportation](https://www.knighttrans.com/) is one of their largest truckload providers. Together, we deliver products to their top customers and keep America moving. We are honored to continue our partnership with the WK Kellogg team.


## A Company-Wide Effort


Winning two major supply chain awards require a true team effort across the entire company. We want to recognize the leaders and associates who made this milestone possible:


- **Account Management** : Senior Account Manager – Kyle Klepper led the charge through daily collaboration with WK Kellogg.
- **National Sales** : VP of National Sales Reefer – Jonathon Jones securing freight opportunities and building long-term relationships with our customers.
- **Driving Associates:** Every driver who hauled a WK Kellogg load delivered unmatched safety and reliability.
- **Operations Team:** Our planners and driver managers working tirelessly behind the scenes to keep freight moving smoothly.


To recognize these achievements, WK Kellogg leaders Robert Morris and Dan Rowles visited our[Indianapolis Terminal](https://www.knighttrans.com/locations/indianapolis-in/) . They personally presented the awards and thanked our terminal crew and drivers. They also presented the honors at our corporate office to[executives](https://www.knighttrans.com/about-us/#knight-leadership) Joe Sherer, Joe Vitiritto, Jonathon Jones, Jenny Tyler, and Keith Knight.


As Jonathon Jones, VP of National Sales –[Reefer](https://www.knighttrans.com/our-services/?services_description_tab=2#services_description) , shared, “Kyle does a phenomenal job with WK. She’s the reason we won this award. She collaborates closely with both the WK Kellogg and Uber teams. They have been tremendous partners to Knight and truly value our capacity and service. When Robert visited our Indy terminal, he thanked everyone – especially our drivers – for our ongoing support.”


## Moving Forward Together


This dual recognition reflects a partnership built on trust, consistent capacity, and exceptional customer service. We thank WK Kellogg for this honor and appreciate every Knight team member who delivers excellence daily.


At Knight Transportation, we deliver reliable logistics solutions for industry leaders like WK Kellogg Co. Explore our full suite of[services](https://www.knighttrans.com/our-services/) and discover how to ship with us today.
